title: SAE J3016 vs Intelligent Textbook Levels
description: Side-by-side comparison of autonomous vehicle and intelligent textbook classification frameworks.
subject: Physics
topic: SAE J3016 vs Intelligent Textbook Levels
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify each SAE J3016 vehicle autonomy level and its counterpart level in the intelligent textbook framework
Explain why both frameworks define levels by system capability and by who holds responsibility, rather than by the underlying technology
Compare the Level 3 threshold in each domain: the vehicle system taking primary control raises liability questions, while a textbook tracking individual learners raises privacy questions
Evaluate how a shared level vocabulary such as J3016 improves communication, regulation, and expectation-setting in a field
Classify a given textbook or vehicle feature into the correct level using the capability criteria shown side by side
